Maya (CS): Heads up — Aldex Health wants a short APAC onboarding pilot (May 20-21). They asked for region pin + CIDR allowlist + QPS bump to validate latency to ap-southeast-1. CIDRs: 103.45.200.0/24, 103.45.201.0/24. Asking for 1200 qps, auto-revoke in 48h after end. Can ops greenlight?
Liu (Net Eng): Quick check: those CIDRs map to their cloud edge (confirmed via whois + Keiko). Good to proceed but prefer more granular port ACLs.
Ravi (Ops): Need exact start/end timestamps, a ticket, cost-center tag, and approval from compliance for data residency. Also recommend we enable rate-windowing so burst doesn't exceed infra SLOs.
Maya (CS): Start: 2025-05-20T08:00:00Z end: 2025-05-21T20:00:00Z. I'll open the ticket and add the cost tag cs_pilot_aldex and link the renewal note (renewal ~6 weeks out).
Evelyn (SRE): Add temporary dashboards for: p95/p99 latency per route, token spend by customer_id, error-rate spikes. I'll also create a short-lived pager rule for >1s tail latency.
Ravi (Ops): Created ticket CS-4789 -> https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4789. Applying allowlist+qps bump after compliance signoff. Will set auto-revoke for 2025-05-23T20:00:00Z.
pipeline-bot: deploy request queued (CS-4789) -> planned change: allowlist-add + qps-set(1200) in ap-southeast-1.
Liu (Net Eng): We will only open the two CIDRs and restrict to API ports. No ASN-level additions.
Evelyn (SRE): Compliance review complete — no sensitive PII flows detected in their sample prompts. Dashboards created: https://grafana.internal/d/Aldex-pilot. Pager on-call is set to secops team.
pipeline-bot: change applied :white_check_mark: (rule: aldex-allow-apse-20250520-01). Auto-revoke scheduled: 2025-05-23T20:00:00Z.
Ravi (Ops): Done. Note: enabled rate-windowing to smooth bursts; sustained QPS above 900 will trigger a billing-alert webhook to CS.
Maya (CS): Test traffic scheduled from their engineer Keiko in 5m, will paste a short sample and latency numbers here. Also will add notes to the customer healthboard and flag renewal risk for sales.
Liu (Net Eng): Recommend warming KV caches with a few repeat canonical prompts before heavy traffic.
Maya (CS): Sending sample logs: 
``n[2025-05-20T08:05:12Z] request_id=rx-9a1 latency=210ms tokens=42 customer=aldex
[2025-05-20T08:05:35Z] request_id=rx-9a2 latency=190ms tokens=38 customer=aldex
``nInitial numbers look good.
Evelyn (SRE): Saw p99 spike to 1.2s at 08:07, SRE investigating but within expected warm-up. Will monitor.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. We'll collect usage and billing impact and put together a 1-page summary for renewal. Please escalate any cost surprises to me directly. :thumbsup:
